methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Capture Git standard error during path-filtered hash operations while preserving nonzero exits and exact blob verification.
methods_detail.failure_signature: A deterministic closeout builder materializes all artifacts but its supervising wrapper times out while hundreds of line-ending conversion warnings are emitted.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Bulk manifest builders must capture predictable conversion-warning streams and verify completion through the deterministic receipt.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the timed-out wrapper at zero credit; preserve attributable files and rerun only the deterministic bounded builder.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Owner-local workflow recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Capture predictable Git conversion warnings during bulk manifest hashing

methods_detail.candidate_workaround: Build the Git index query directly from the owner manifest entries and self-exclusions before comparing object identifiers.
methods_detail.failure_signature: An independent owner-manifest probe queries only closeout-era global paths and falsely reports inherited owner files as mismatches.
methods_detail.recurrence_guard: Never use a manually truncated path list for owner-manifest parity.
methods_detail.rollback: Retain the false-negative read-only probe at zero credit; no repository content was changed by the probe.
methods_detail.scope_boundary: Owner-local validation recovery only; no scientific, production, independent-reproduction, or authority credit.
methods_detail.title: Derive owner-index audits from the manifest path set

witnesses.observed: The first closeout wrapper timed out at sixty seconds after artifact materialization while Git emitted repeated conversion warnings.
The deterministic recovery captured the warning stream, completed within its bound, and exposed its build receipt.
The first owner-manifest probe omitted eighteen inherited owner-global paths from its Git index query and reported false mismatches.
The corrected probe derived every queried path from the owner manifest and found exact object parity.
